'''NA:''' paraworld#369 |checkboxAutoTeams=Yes |checkbox2=No |role=Mid |issub1=No |istrainee1=No |issub2=No |istrainee2=No |issub3=No |istrainee3=No |issub4=No |istrainee4=No |issub5=No |istrainee5=No |checkbox3=No |stream=https://www.huya.com/knight9 |weibo=https://www.weibo.com/n/Knight522 |lolpros=https://lolpros.gg/player/knight |deeplol=https://www.deeplol.gg/pro/knight-Zhuo_Ding |dpmlol=https://dpm.lol/pro/Knight |checkboxSuppressOrgNavbox=No |checkboxSBS=Yes |checkboxTOCR=Yes |checkboxIsSub=No }} ==Biography== == Trivia == * Regarded as one of the best Midlanders in the whole world since 2019, also known for his constant 1v9 performances. * Held Rank 1 in the Korean solo queue several times. * Uses his left hand to control the mouse and his right hand for the keyboard. ** Nicknamed ''Golden Left Hand'' by Chinese casters. * Good friends with [[YaGao]]. They are from the same city (Pingxiang) and met in an internet cafe before they became professional players. ** [[YaGao]] beat him to become the #1 mid of Pingxiang. ** Played as a jungler when they were in the same internet cafe team, with [[YaGao]] as the mid-laner. * Known for his {{ci|Ekko}} and {{ci|Zoe}}. Holds a high win rate with these champions. * Holds an extremely high win rate as {{ci|ahri}}, includes a 28 win-streak. * Known for building {{ii|Mejai's Soulstealer}} constantly, which led to the [[LoL Pro League | LPL's]] English cast to measure up other Midlanders in the league based on this habit. * His ID '''Knight''' is actually ''K-Night''. He wanted the name ''Night'' but it was taken by another account. He randomly added a K to the start of the word, not knowing that ''knight'' is also a word in English.[https://medium.com/@ritaleung_1102/tes-knight-growth-of-the-best-chinese-mid-laner-241d95797087 TES Knight: Growth of the best Chinese mid laner] ''medium.com'' * Holds the record for the most solo kills in a single regular split. He recorded 35 solo kills in [[LPL/2021 Season/Summer Season| LPL 2021 Summer]]. === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on August 8, 2020. ** The 24th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL. * Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on January 15, 2022. ** The 15th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL. ** Needed the 2nd fewest games to reach 1500 kills after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]]. * Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on September 1, 2022. ** The 10th player to reach 2000 kills in the LPL. ** Needed the 2nd fewest games to reach 2000 kills after Uzi. * Reached 2500 kills in the LPL on February 24, 2024. ** The 7th player to reach 2500 kills in the LPL. ** Needed the 2nd fewest games to reach 2500 kills after Uzi. * Reached 3000 kills in the LPL on February 26, 2025. ** The 4th player to reach 3000 kills in the LPL. ** [[JackeyLove]] claimed the same milestone in the same match. * Reached 3500 kills in the LPL on August 13, 2025. ** The 3rd player to reach 3500 Kills in the LPL after [[Rookie]] and [[xiaohu]]. * Reached 4000 kills in the LPL on April 26, 2026. ** The 3rd player to reach 4000 Kills in the LPL after [[Rookie]] and [[xiaohu]]. * Reached 300 wins in the LPL on March 12, 2023. ** [[Chovy]] got his LCK 300 wins on the same day. ** Was the 15th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL after [[Clearlove]], [[meiko]], [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], [[Flandre]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiye]], [[Lwx]], [[JackeyLove]], [[Crisp]], and [[Yagao]]. * Reached 400 wins in the LPL on June 18, 2024. This time 4 days after Chovy ** Was the 8th player to reach 400 wins in the LPL after [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], [[JackeyLove]], and [[Yagao]]. * Reached 500 wins in the LPL on August 10, 2025. ** Was the 6th player to reach 500 wins in the LPL after [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], Rookie, Scout, and JackeyLove. * Reached 500 games in the LPL on June 8, 2023 ** The 18th player to reach 500 games in the LPL. * Reached 600 games in the LPL on June 27, 2024 ** The 12th player to reach 600 games in the LPL. * Reached 700 games in the LPL on May 13, 2025 ** The 9th player to reach 700 games in the LPL after meiko, xiaohu, Rookie, Scout, Flandre, Crisp, JackeyLove, and Doinb. * Reached 800 games in the LPL on January 31, 2026 ** The 8th player to reach 800 games in the LPL after meiko, xiaohu, Rookie, Scout, Flandre, Crisp, and JackeyLove. * Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on June 27, 2023. ** Was the 23rd player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on April 10, 2025. ** Was the 18th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL. === Individual Awards === * Finals MVP x7 (LPL Summer 2020, MSI 2023, LPL Summer 2023, Demacia Cup 2023, LPL Summer 2024, LPL Grand Finals 2025, Split 2 2026) * LPL MVP x5 (Summer 2019, Summer 2020, Spring 2024, Split 2 2026, Split 3 2026) * LPL 1st All-Pro Team x10 (Summer 2019, Summer 2020, Summer 2023, Spring 2024, Summer 2024, Split 2 2025, Split 3 2025, Split 1 2026, Split 2 2026, Split 3 2026) * LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x4 (Spring 2019, Summer 2021, Summer 2022, Spring 2023) * LPL 3rd All-Pro Team x3 (Spring 2020, Spring 2021, Split 1 2025) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} == Media == {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
